## About
Willow Automotive Service works on Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, BMW and every other kind of luxury, exotic and special interest vehicle from our shop on Wabash in the South Loop. Routine maintenance, major overhauls and performance work all happen under one roof, and we only use OEM parts.
Our sales and service sides work together. We keep a selection of pre-owned specialty cars for sale, and most of them come from our own customers, so we know their condition and service history.
Customers often mention Brian by name, along with straight answers and work done the right way. We are rated 4.8 from 32 Google reviews.

## Services
- Maintenance and overhauls: From an oil change to a major overhaul, we look after Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, BMW and other specialty cars.
- Computer tuning: ECU reprogramming that adds performance without invasive changes.
- Forced induction: Turbo and supercharger systems, either installed aftermarket or designed for your specific car.
- Custom exhaust: A tuned exhaust built for your car, for more performance or a more aggressive sound.
- Performance brakes and suspension: High performance brake setups and suspension work for better stopping power and handling, on the street or at the track.
- Collection management: One point of contact for an entire collection, including scheduled rotation for preventive maintenance and help tracking down rare parts.
- Sales and consignment: Pre-owned specialty cars, from daily drivers to collection pieces, often from existing customers whose service history we know.
- Indoor storage and battery maintenance: A place to keep your car indoors with its battery looked after.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in Mercedes-Benz, Porsche and BMW, along with other luxury, exotic and special interest vehicles.

Q: Can you work on older or classic cars?
A: Yes. Owners of vintage Mercedes tell us we understand their cars, including older fuel injection systems.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Give us a call at 312.881.0101 and we will set up a time.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I buy a car from you without seeing it in person?
A: One customer bought from us remotely, relying on photos and Brian's word, and said he patiently answered every question.
